name: What information should I prepare before meeting with a design-build team about architectural drawings for my project?

mainEntity.name: What information should I prepare before meeting with a design-build team about architectural drawings for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with AKN Design Group, preparing key information can significantly streamline the architectural drawing process. Consider gathering inspiration images of designs you admire, compiling a list of your functional needs for the space (e.g., more storage, better flow, specific features), and having a general understanding of your desired budget range. This preparation helps our team grasp your vision and practical requirements, allowing us to develop CAD-supported layouts that reflect your unique lifestyle and aesthetic preferences from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before discussing architectural drawings, prepare inspiration images, a list of functional needs, and your desired budget to help our team understand your vision.
